d: Barnaby and Winter's investigations lead them deep into a world haunted by a potentially deadly curse.
The appearance of a headless horseman at Quitewell Hall foreshadows a number of deaths.
When a barrister is killed in Midsomer, suspicion falls on convicted murderer Grady Felton.
The murder of a journalist has echoes of a 1960s horror film starring Midsomers own Stella Harris.
